basic_info.description: Your new home awaits at 678 Vienna. This inviting home features a seamless flow between living spaces, perfect for entertaining and everyday comfort. The updated kitchen boasts new countertops and updated appliances, while the stylish bathroom is equipped with modern fixtures.  Enjoy the spacious, paved backyard, offering endless possibilities for outdoor enjoyment. The garage level includes a convenient 2-car tandem garage along with additional room and bathroom.   Located just moments from Mission Street and Geneva Avenue, this home provides easy access to the 101 and 280 freeways, making commuting a breeze. Additionally, you'll find Crocker Amazon Park nearby, perfect for outdoor recreation and relaxation. Don't miss your chance to own this charming home in a prime location!
